484: 	private JavacNode generateBuilderAbstractClass(SuperBuilderJob job, JCExpression superclassBuilderClass, List<JCExpression> superclassTypeParams, String classGenericName, String builderGenericName) {
485: 		rememberBuilderSession(job, job.parentType, job.parentType.getTreeMaker());
486: 		this.sessionClassGenericName = classGenericName;
487: 		this.sessionBuilderGenericName = builderGenericName;
488: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = this.sessionMaker;
489: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.STATIC | Flags.ABSTRACT | Flags.PUBLIC);
490: 
491: 		// Keep any type params of the annotated class.
492: 		ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter> allTypeParams = new ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter>();
493: 		allTypeParams.appendList(copyTypeParams(job.sourceNode, job.typeParams));
494: 		// Add builder-specific type params required for inheritable builders.
495: 		// 1. The return type for the build() method, named "C", which extends the annotated class.
496: 		JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.typeParams);
497: 
498: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass)));
499: 		// 2. The return type for all setter methods, named "B", which extends this builder class.
500: 		Name builderClassName = job.toName(job.builderClassName);
501: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
502: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
503: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
504: 		JCTypeApply typeApply = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, builderClassName, false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
505: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(builderGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(typeApply)));
506: 
507: 		JCExpression extending = null;
508: 		if (superclassBuilderClass != null) {
509: 			// If the annotated class extends another class, we want this builder to extend the builder of the superclass.
510: 			// 1. Add the type parameters of the superclass.
511: 			typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(superclassTypeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
512: 			// 2. Add the builder type params <C, B>.
513: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
514: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
515: 			extending = maker.TypeApply(superclassBuilderClass, typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
516: 		}
517: 
518: 		JCClassDecl builder = maker.ClassDef(mods, builderClassName, allTypeParams.toList(), extending, List.<JCExpression>nil(), List.<JCTree>nil());
519: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builder, job.sourceNode);
520: 		return injectType(job.parentType, builder);
521: 	}
